snippet.title: Developer commentary trailer | Noelle
snippet.description:
This is the official developer commentary trailer for Noelle.

In this video, we discuss the themes of the game, which include grief, depression and the feeling of isolation during the festive season. Noelle is a short, emotional winter horror game centred around atmosphere, memory and choice.

If this sounds like something you'd be interested in, consider adding the game to your Steam wishlist.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4143780/Noelle/
Release date: 18 December 2025.

Thank you for watching.
